description: This file defines an API router for handling CRUD operations related to healthcare consultations, including role-based access control (RBAC). It includes endpoints for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting consultation records, each with associated validation and permission checks.

methods.name: Consultation _consultation_from_doc(doc: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Maps a MongoDB consultation document to a Consultation model instance.

methods.name: Optional[str] _get_patient_id_for_user(db, user_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves the patient document ID for a given user ID.

methods.name: Optional[str] _get_doctor_id_for_user(db, user_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves the doctor document ID for a given user ID.

methods.name: List[Consultation] list_consultations(user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user))
methods.description: Lists consultations accessible to the current user based on their role.

methods.name: Consultation create_consultation( payload: ConsultationCreate, user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(role_required(["admin", "doctor"])), )
methods.description: Creates a new consultation record, with access restricted based on role.

methods.name: Consultation get_consultation( consultation_id: str = Path(..., description="Consultation document id"), user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Retrieves a specific consultation by ID, with access controlled by RBAC.

methods.name: Consultation update_consultation( consultation_id: str, payload: ConsultationUpdate, user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(get_current_user), )
methods.description: Updates a consultation record, restricted to admin or associated doctor.

methods.name: None delete_consultation( consultation_id: str, _: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(role_required(["admin"])), )
methods.description: Deletes a consultation record; admin only.

ctags.name: create_consultation
ctags.signature: ( payload: ConsultationCreate, user_claims: Dict[str, Any] = Depends(role_required(["admin", "doctor"])), )
